xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5585: Phone-width conversation page: Agents rail squeezes the timeline to 130 px and the top bar overflows

plan.title: Phone-width conversation page: Agents rail squeezes the timeline to 130 px and the top bar overflows
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One cohesive phone-width fix. Code lives in two roots only (src/dashboard/frontend and apps/mobile/src/shell/ShellApp.tsx); the subsystem count of 7 comes from the naive first-two-segments heuristic counting each top-level doc file (docs/CONVERSATION-SUBAGENTS.md, docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, features/conversations.mdx, changelog.d/pan-5585.md, docs/screenshots/pan-5585) as its own subsystem. File count is 24, under the limit.

narratives.Problem: At phone width (393 px, 360 px) the conversation page is unusable: the open Agents rail (SubagentRail) is a 256 px inline flex sibling that leaves the timeline and composer about 137 px, the AppChrome top bar and its menus run past the viewport edges, the conversation header clips the Conversation | Terminal switch, and on iOS the keyboard pushes the phone shell's header under the status bar because the shells are fixed inset-0 / 100vh and do not follow window.visualViewport.
narratives.Proposal: On a narrow pane (< 760 px) render the open rail as an absolute overlay inside the conversation row (min(100%,320px) from the right, above a scrim; strip stays in flow) that closes on scrim, X or any row tap. Below Tailwind sm (640 px) compact the top bar with CSS-only max-sm: variants (hide wordmark, crumb, search text/keycap, exception chips; Agents and Needs-you show dot + number) and anchor its three menus to the bar. Add a 520 px container query so the header title takes its own line and the actions wrap. Add lib/visualViewport.ts (useVisualViewportVars writes --app-height / --app-offset-top) and size #root, body, the App root and both phone shells (.app-viewport-shell) to them. Prove it with a WebKit iPhone Playwright spec on an isolated dashboard with seeded subagent transcripts, and update the docs and changelog.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Native changes: no @capacitor/keyboard, no iOS or Android project edits
- Redesigning the composer toolbar or its picker labels
- Escape-to-close or a focus trap for the overlay rail
- Surfacing low-cost mode or build-behind-main on a phone (hidden below 640 px)
- Changing StandaloneRoutes.tsx popout roots (h-screen) or the /m header layouts
- Removing the MobileConversations.tsx header-wrap arbitrary variants
- Any change to rail persistence keys, defaultCollapsed, or toggleSignal semantics
- Any layout change at >= 640 px (top bar), >= 760 px pane width (rail), or > 520 px header container width
- Adding the new Playwright spec to the CI test:playwright script

autoDecisions.summary: Overlay rail is absolute inside the conversation row (row gains relative), not fixed or a portal.
autoDecisions.rationale: Narrow panes also occur in desktop split layouts; fixed would cover the whole window.

autoDecisions.summary: The 30 px strip stays in flow while the overlay is open.
autoDecisions.rationale: Removing it would reflow the virtualized timeline on every open and close; the scrim covers it.
It is one of the two options the issue lists and leaves a tappable scrim strip at 393 px.

autoDecisions.summary: Exception chips are hidden below 640 px.
autoDecisions.rationale: At 360 px the bar budget (~306 px with compact chips) has no room for them; Deacon-frozen and stopped-agent state stay reachable in the System-health popover.

autoDecisions.summary: Only the System-health popover gets bar anchoring below 640 px; the Agents and Needs-you menus are unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: They render through MenuSurface, which already caps width at 100vw-1rem and translates the surface back into the viewport; the System-health popover is a plain div with no constraint.

autoDecisions.summary: Keyboard fix uses window.visualViewport via CSS variables, with 100dvh fallback; vars are removed while pinch-zoomed.
autoDecisions.rationale: dvh does not track the iOS software keyboard; visualViewport does. Removing vars at scale != 1 keeps pinch-zoom from dragging the shell.

autoDecisions.summary: Composer footer truncation is treated as a consequence of the rail fix, asserted only as no overflow at 360 px.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Fix and acceptance lists contain no composer item; the truncation came from the 137 px squeeze.

autoDecisions.summary: The Playwright spec runs WebKit via devices['iPhone 15 Pro'], seeds real subagent files, and stays out of CI test:playwright.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI installs Chromium only and the spec seeds git repositories, like pan-5295; real files exercise the WS path a mocked /messages route would skip.

autoDecisions.summary: iOS keyboard behavior is an implementation checkpoint: verified headless where possible, PR states device verification limits.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue explicitly allows this; Playwright WebKit has no software keyboard.

autoDecisions.summary: useVisualViewportVars is called in App, MobileApp and ShellApp instead of the two entry files.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the plan under the 25-file surface limit; multiple callers write identical values.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-6 exactly. Create lib/visualViewport.ts with APP_HEIGHT_VAR='--app-height', APP_OFFSET_TOP_VAR='--app-offset-top', applyVisualViewportVars(root, vv) (removes both vars when |scale-1| > 0.01, else sets Math.floor(height) and Math.floor(offsetTop) in px) and useVisualViewportVars() (useEffect: no-op without window.visualViewport; update once, then on visualViewport resize and scroll; cleanup removes only the listeners). Add visualViewport.test.ts with the three tests in WI-6 step 2 (stub window.visualViewport with an EventTarget-based fake; no timers). index.css @layer base: body keeps `min-height: 100vh` and adds `min-height: var(--app-height, 100dvh)`; #root keeps `height: 100vh` and adds `height: var(--app-height, 100dvh)`; add the `.app-viewport-shell` rule (position fixed; left 0; right 0; top var(--app-offset-top, 0px); height 100vh then var(--app-height, 100dvh)). App.tsx line 805: `h-screen` -> `h-[var(--app-height,100dvh)]` plus `pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)]`; call useVisualViewportVars() right before `const [activeTab, setActiveTabState] = useState<Tab>(`.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-8. New spec modeled on tests/pan-5295-conversation-turn.spec.ts: file-level test.use({ ...devices['iPhone 15 Pro'] }); serial; 180 s timeout. beforeAll: temp dir with overdeck home and fake HOME, run scripts/dev/seed-workflow-fixture.ts as pan-5295 does, startIsolatedDashboard({ home, env: { HOME: fakeHome } }), GET /api/conversations/fixture-1 for id, cwd and claudeSessionId, then write two subagents (agent-pan5585a Explore 'Trace the phone layout' toolu_pan5585_a depth 1; agent-pan5585b general-purpose depth 1) as .jsonl + .meta.json under join(claudeProjectDir(cwd, claudeProjectsRoot(fakeHome)), claudeSessionId, 'subagents'); each JSONL = the parent transcript's FIRST line (user record) and LAST line (assistant text record) with sessionId, uuid, parentUuid and text replaced (the seed script's transcript() helper is not exported), assistant text 'Phone layout subagent reply'. beforeEach: patchLiveSession (sessionAlive true for fixture-1), dark theme init script, remove overdeck.ui.agentsRailCollapsed. Tests 4-7 from PRD WI-8: close the work dock if [data-testid=work-dock] is visible, then overlay at 393 and 360 with body width >= conversation-pane-row width - 31 and screenshots; row tap closes overlay and shows 'Phone layout subagent reply' with subagent=pan5585a in the URL; at 360 no descendant of [data-testid=topbar], [data-machine-state] or [class*=composerToolbar] has right > innerWidth + 0.5, both Conversation/Terminal tabs visible, and agents-menu, the 'Needs you' menu and #system-health-popover each open with left >= 0 and right <= innerWidth; --app-height equals innerHeight px and #root height equals innerHeight. If seeding subagents fails to surface the rail, debug the transcript path via GET /api/conversations/fixture-1/messages (its subagents array) before changing approach.
